market.summary: Prioritize university central libraries and substantial public/research shrine libraries. IFLA describes public libraries as locally managed and universities under university presidencies/Ministry of Higher Education. The evidence supports Koha as a practical adapter priority, not a measured national market share. Physical books must be separated from repositories, electronic book services and thesis unions.
market.platform_strategy: First pilot Baghdad Koha and build narrow adapters for the national OPAC and Mustansiriyah physical-loans catalog. Investigate lib.iq public JSON union frontend with library-item filtering and edition safeguards; it offers the clearest demonstrated multi-institution reach. Reliability and reuse conditions need resolution before integration. WinISIS and SLiMS evidence is institution-specific.

limitations: Five selected and two reserves: short by five selected, despite fourteen substantial priorities and meaningful alternatives.
No national largest-ten ranking or LMS market share established. Dated collection totals and institutional proxies are not directly comparable.
Union count includes four distinct institutions proven by returned item holdings, not a union plus branches. Imam Hussain Babylon branch is not separately counted.
Union rows can merge different publication years under one record; preserve institution item provenance and do not assume edition identity.

Root diagnostic controls independently showed identical proxy503 on example.com, World Bank, NOUN and CERN during the late failure wave. Late503s are execution-network failures, not evidence of Iraq-specific outages or absence of holdings.
English queries succeeded; Arabic Hamdaniya query failed503. Kurdish not exercised because relevant catalog access was unresolved.
No app changes, live adapter integration, authentication, challenge/TLS bypass, private-IP fetches, cookies/account persistence or outreach.
No library reuse licence or general borrowing/visitor eligibility established.
